title: Obesity summary (real CC-BY prose from Our World in Data)

source.attribution: Our World in Data (Ritchie, Roser), CC-BY-4.0
source.notes: Composed from real Our World in Data figures (CC-BY): more than a third of US adults obese in 2016; over 60% of US adults overweight or obese; ~two-fifths of adults worldwide overweight or obese. Complements added (not-obese / healthy-weight shares) and verified consistent (1/3 + 2/3 = 1; 60% + 40%; two-fifths = 40%) before injecting 3 defects.
